data.context: In *The Australian Mining Industry: More than Just Shovels and Being the Lucky Country* (2015), section 3.1, “Summary Data Set,” this passage describes mining patent families identified from applications with priority dates between 1 January 1994 and 31 October 2011. It explains how the dataset was assembled and compares inventions and patents per applicant across operating miners, METS firms and publicly funded entities.
